title: 配置智驾专区运行域调用令牌
description: 请输入访问智驾专区运行域 MCP 端点的调用令牌。凭据仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter the MCP access token for the ADC zone runtime-domain endpoint. Credentials are stored locally under ~/.workbuddy and never uploaded.

fields.label: MCP 调用令牌
fields.placeholder_en: Request it from the service owner
fields.description: 用于访问本连接器 MCP 端点的静态令牌（服务端对应 BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN），仅保存在您本机。⚠️ 与 `adc-approval` 用的是**同一个**令牌 —— 两个端点在同一宿主上、同一套鉴权，不需要两把。注意它与「智驾助手」的 OAuth 授权是两套凭据。
fields.description_en: Static token for this connector's MCP endpoint (BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN on the server), stored locally only. ⚠️ It is the SAME token as `adc-approval` — both endpoints share one host and one auth stack.
